strings.en: Al-Van Ranks, here I come!
Charge, Raftclans Aurun!
One who bears a sword needs no hesitation./　Have at you!
I, Al-Van Ranks, will stake my life/　and fight to the very end!
Ride on, Aurun!/　You and I shall fight on until/　the flames of our lives burn out!
Loyalty has its time and place! Stand down!
Even you would turn your blades/　on Lady Shana-Mia?!
If you refuse to withdraw no matter what...!
Do not block my path. Stand aside!
Jua-Mu.../　You won't withdraw even if I ask, will you...
Jua-Mu... I believe in the future/　that Lady Shana-Mia will bring...!
Karo-Ran!/　Raising your hand against Lady Shana-Mia/　makes you nothing but traitors!
I will avenge Lord E-Selda's bitter end!
I knowingly commit the grave sin of disloyalty!/　Knight Commander, prepare yourself!
For Lady Shana-Mia, for my people,/　and for my late teacher.../　Al-Van Ranks, here I come!
Gu-Landon Gortz.../　Return to the darkness of Voda by my sword!
Monstrous one.../　I, Al-Van Ranks, shall be your opponent!
No divine dragon, but an evil one!/　Prepare yourself!
Skull Knight, as a knight, I challenge you!
Even if you are a being/　akin to Fureim, the Creator God...!
Even if my foe is a being equal to a god,/　I cannot retreat from this battle!
I, the knight Al-Van Ranks, to protect/　the people of many stars,/　shall destroy XN-L with my sword!
Begone, Jevilun!
Eliminating Jevilun!
No matter what form Jevilun takes...!
Giant Jevilun... disperse!
To force it out/　of that position...!
Then allow me to answer in kind!
You will not retreat? Then so be it!
I accept this challenge!
You cannot escape my reach.
No intention of retreating? Then here I come!
I let my guard down...!
Kh! My Raftclans...!
You do well, facing me...!
To think I would be driven back this far...!
Kh! My inexperience is no laughing matter!
Did I misjudge their power...?!
You can fight me as an equal, or better...!
To think my Raftclans/　would be pushed back this far...!
Nngh...!/　I must fight in a way that brings no shame to a knight!
I, Al-Van Ranks,/　cannot retreat yet!
I swore to fight with my life on the line./　That is why I cannot retreat over this!
Strong... truly strong./　That is what gives this fight meaning!
So this is your hatred...!
Karo-Ran!/　You cannot cut down my cause!
As a knight, I cannot lose!/　This is where it begins, Skull Knight!
Ngh! I must stop Zee-Gadin at once,/　or Gaw-La will...!
Guh! Not yet, XN-L!/　I'll fight on until my life's flame goes out!
Oh, not bad.
I see... They are desperate as well.
To catch me... A formidable opponent.
Is that all? Do not underestimate me.
You can match/　this Raftclans Aurun...!
A good attack./　But not enough to stop the Raftclans.
I, Al-Van Ranks,/　will not retreat over something like this!
It seems I must admit you're a foe/　worth fighting with all my strength!
Calm your heart!/　You'll destroy yourself, Jua-Mu Dalubi!
I cannot let you/　do any more than this...!
My voice doesn't reach you...! But still!
Ngh! I didn't mean to underestimate/　the Karokuala, but...!
The Knight Commander shows no hesitation at all.../　Naturally!
The evil dragon is faster than I thought...!
I won't fall yet, XN-L!
Jevilun has this much power...!
This much is nothing.
Is that how you mean to stop me?
My Raftclans will not be shaken by damage this slight.
Do not think that will stop a knight.
I, Al-Van Ranks,/　will not be shaken by that much.
Too shallow. Come at me with everything!
Heh, a good read...!
Careless. How unlike me...
A wound like this.../　is nothing to one who survived/　the great war.
Jua-Mu, you'd land a blow on me...!
I accept this wound./　But it's not too late, even now. Withdraw!
So you hit me./　But you must withdraw here!
That was a feeble attack/　for the Chief Agent.
As expected of the Knight Commander.../　But I too have reasons not to retreat!
You live up to the title of knight...!
Monstrous one, is that all?
That attack falls short of the Basileus.
Is this the extent of XN-L's power?/　No, I must not underestimate it.
Sloppy aim.
Inexperienced.
I can easily see through that much.
You underestimated this Raftclans.
That will not work on me, Al-Van Ranks.
You won't hit me that easily!
Do not underestimate my Raftclans Aurun.
This is what it means to face a knight!
Forgive me, Jua-Mu./　I had to do this...
Stop this./　You cannot shoot me down!
Stand back. Do not get in my way!
Karo-Ran, I know your tricks!
So this is Zee-Gadin.../　But if it doesn't hit, it can't hurt me!
You won't hit me, skeletal knight!
Heh. A knight cannot fall to a dragon.
Even a being close to a god/　leaves an opening I can exploit!
An attack from the likes of Jevilun!
Whatever its form, it's still just Jevilun.
Such an attack will not work on me.
My beloved machine, which fought through/　the great war of old.../　It will not be scratched so easily.
Such an attack has no effect.
How pointless...
That attack will not work.
You will not get through the Orgone Cloud.
The Orgone Cloud can block it completely.
You chose the wrong method of attack.
That trick won't work.
Hm... I cannot counter. How unlike me.
A blunder... I cannot strike.
Have I been drawn into my opponent's pace?
I must change my position.
For an enemy, you move well...
You managed to escape well...
Sorry, but I can't let that opening pass.
I'll strike as well.
Your habits haven't changed, Karin.
Karin... You want me to follow? Very well.
I'll follow the Throne Unit, as in battles of old.
Tou-Ya, I'll lend you a hand.
Leave this to me!
My Raftclans can take this!
Karin, I can't afford to lose you!
Karin, let this be some small atonement...!
Protecting the Throne Unit is a knight's duty!
Lady Shana-Mia, I will protect you!
You will not escape with such sloppy moves!
Prepare yourself!
Can you parry this Continuous Attack?!
Take this blow!
There!
Fall!
I won't miss!
I have read your movements... In that case!
At this range!
Orgone Claw, deploy!
Moving to close combat!
Orgone Claw!
Got you!
Take this!
You're mine!
One more strike!
Receive this, Orgone Cannon!
Orgone Cannon, wide-area mode!
Orgone Materialization...!
Here I come!
Receive the ever-changing blade.
Seiyah!
Hah!
Orgonite Mirage!
Sever!!
Hmph!
Hyaah!
Come forth,/　Orgonite Mirage!
Seiyaaah!!
Busker Mode, activate!
Materialization!
Behold my secret technique!
Hyah!
Haaaah!!
Now I shall show you the true worth of my sword!
Extractor, maximum!
This greatsword!
You can't parry this!
Prepare yourself!!
Haaaaah!!
Into the darkness of Voda...
Orgonite!
Busker!!
Swoooooord!!
All foes shall fall before this sword.
Haaah!
Raaaah!!
Not yet!
My sword has another form!
Extend, blade of Orgonite!
My true blade!
Haaaaaah!!
Into the abyss of Voda...
Sink!
A blow with everything I've got!
Feel it in your very body!!
Take thiiiiis!!
After the light, darkness comes.
